extracted.name: Norwegian Waffles
extracted.description: This recipe for sweet, rich, Norwegian waffles has been in my husband’s family for generations. It is sure to be a favorite with everyone at the table.
instruction_lines: Preheat a waffle iron according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Sift flour and baking powder together into a bowl.
Beat eggs and sugar in a separate bowl with an electric mixer until fluffy. Add milk, melted shortening, salt, and vanilla; mix until well blended. Mix in flour mixture.
Spoon 2/3 cup batter onto the preheated waffle iron. Close the iron and cook until waffle is golden brown and the iron stops steaming, about 5 minutes. Repeat to cook remaining waffles.
